novelty_flags.label: Proposal-level related work and all multi-variant headline results
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits Perényi and Stensrud (2025), a directly adjacent published Biometrics paper defining variant-specific causal and time-to-event challenge estimands and explicitly identifying sharp bounds under weaker assumptions as future work.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition: reference-positivity-dual
soundness_flags.one_line: The quantified positivity assumption is vacuous when the fiber is empty, while the displayed minimum/dual LP is infeasible or undefined; add P(b,q,omega) nonempty or explicitly define infeasibility as failure before asserting the iff.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition: reference-positivity-dual
soundness_flags.one_line: After the canonical-system definition, this is only the definition of fiber-wide positivity plus standard LP strong duality, with no substantive new claim; demote it to an audit lemma or make a nonroutine diagnostic consequence the result.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem: pooled-sign-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: Given the preceding claim Theta_I=[L,U], each stated sign equivalence is an endpoint-definition unfold; retain it as a corollary rather than a standalone root research target.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition: biological-waning-translation
soundness_flags.one_line: Under the asserted equal positive placebo risks, the conclusion is direct ratio algebra and should be a calibration corollary, not a standalone proposition-level contribution.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-reciprocal-endpoints; thm:pooled-sign-frontier; thm:common-history-sign-dual
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Finite reciprocal endpoints and strict-sign certificates are conditional on ass:reference-risk-positivity, an LP-checkable fiber-wide denominator restriction.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Sharp finite endpoint and sign claims are made only UNDER nonempty compatibility and fiber-wide reference-risk positivity; the zero-denominator extended set remains the unconditional target.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 point-identifies the first-interval challenge effect and gives sharp bounds for the second-interval single-pathogen challenge effect under Assumptions 1-5.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 2-4, especially Section 4 Temporal Properties of VE Measures
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines multi-variant/multi-vaccine VE measures and derives when them can be time-varying under leaky and all-or-none action mechanisms.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid random sets for an identified set and known images thereof, including uniform-in-P validity conditions.
The paper formalizes variant-specific causal estimands, includes a time-to-event extension, and states that sharp partial identification under weaker assumptions is future work.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Perényi and Stensrud (2025) to the bibliography and state precisely which of its time-to-event/variant-specific challenge estimands is nested, why its identifying assumptions do not yield this external-margin fiber, and the strict class or data-configuration extension supplied here.

Repair the empty-fiber convention in the positivity proposition, then demote the LP-duality, interval-sign, and placebo-risk algebra rows to corollaries/implementation lemmas so the root claims carry the nontrivial compression and sharpness content.

Sharpen one open question into a theorem-level comparator boundary: give a necessary-and-sufficient observable condition under which the Perényi--Stensrud time-to-event or case-only functional coincides with the proposed sharp set, with a separating compatible-law witness otherwise.

recommended_next_step: Revise the survey and theorem hierarchy, repair the empty-fiber positivity statement, then continue on this field-tier partial-identification angle.
